title: Marathon Reveals Major Nightfall Update and December PvE Expansion
summary: Bungie has revealed a major roadmap for Marathon, including refreshed progression, new rewards and a permanent PvE experience planned for December.
content:
Bungie has announced a major update roadmap for Marathon, its sci-fi extraction shooter. The October Nightfall Refresh focuses on progression, rewards and changes designed to improve the overall live experience.

The update resets player progression and equipment, refreshes the in-game economy and introduces a new NuCal-inspired Reward Pass at no additional cost to players who own the game. Bungie has also outlined adjustments to weapons, Runner abilities and matchmaking activities.

The next major milestone is Marathon: Symbiosis, planned for December 8, 2026. It is expected to introduce the game's first permanent PvE experience, an expanded Perimeter, a new Runner shell named Bishop, a social space and a firing range. Bungie has also outlined further connected PvE and PvP experiences for March.

faq.question: What is the Marathon Nightfall Refresh?
faq.answer: It is an update focused on progression, rewards, the in-game economy and gameplay adjustments.

faq.question: When does Marathon Symbiosis arrive?
faq.answer: Bungie has announced December 8, 2026, as the planned release date.

faq.question: Will Marathon get a permanent PvE mode?
faq.answer: Yes. Bungie says the Symbiosis update will introduce Marathon's first permanent PvE experience.

faq.question: Who is Bishop in Marathon?
faq.answer: Bishop is a new Runner shell planned for the Symbiosis update, designed around speed and powerful melee attacks.
